subject: Production traffic & budget checkpoint — hosted API

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Production traffic & budget checkpoint — hosted API

Thanks again for the call earlier today — quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together a tailored hosted pricing estimate and pilot plan. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Key notes from our conversation:
- Primary integration: product personalization API invoked at page load + background re-ranks for email digests.
- Expected monthly active users (MAU): ~120k (across US and EU).
- Tokens per user: rough average 1,000–1,400 per month (median ~1,200).
- Rough monthly token ranges: low 100M / likely 140M / high 200M.
- Peak TPS profile: sustained baseline ~6 TPS; short bursts up to ~50 TPS (1–5 minute spikes) during batch sends/events.
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 350ms for realtime completions; background jobs can tolerate higher.
- Target unit economics you mentioned on-call: target $/1M tokens ~ $700 (flexible).

As next steps, could you confirm the following so we can finalize a proposal and pilot sizing:
1) Confirm the monthly token estimate you want us to size for (pick low / likely / high).
2) Confirm typical burst duration and frequency (e.g., 50 TPS for 2 minutes once per day vs sustained hour-long peaks).
3) Any constraints on retention/ingestion (logs, KV cache) and whether 30-day retention is OK for pilot?
4) Budget band per month you’re comfortable committing to for a 3-month pilot (helps with pricing tiers).

I attached a small volume template (avery_volume_sheet.csv) — drop your numbers in the shaded columns and send back. Marissa will use that to map to pricing bands once you confirm.

If it helps, we can propose a pilot that includes a 30-day burst buffer and a capped overage with predictable $/1M token pricing.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Jamie Lowe <jamie@averytech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Deepa Rao <deepa@averytech.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production traffic & budget checkpoint — hosted API

Hi Karthik — thanks for the write-up, this aligns with our notes. I filled the volume template and attached it (avery_volume_sheet.csv). Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly token sizing: we'd like you to size for the "likely" case (around 140M tokens/month) but include headroom to 200M for launch month.
- Bursts: typically 40–50 TPS for ~2–3 minutes, happens ~3–5 times per day (notifications and scheduled digest pushes).
- Streaming vs completions: ~85% standard completions, ~15% streaming (progressive content updates).
- Retention: 30 days is fine for pilot telemetry. For long-term we may need 90 days.
- Budget: our procurement target is ~$60k–$85k/month for the initial three months; ideally we land closer to the middle. We are aiming for target unit economics of ~$700/1M tokens but can accept up to $800 with committed volume.

Attached: a csv with per-feature token breakdown. Let me know if you need the user-level breakdowns unredacted.

Cheers,
Jamie Lowe
Head of Product, Avery Tech
jamie@averytech.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Got it — thanks Jamie, that’s really helpful. A couple quick follow-ups before Marissa puts together pricing bands: 

- For the bursts you described (40–50 TPS x 2–3 min, ~4x/day), can you confirm if those are mostly full-completion calls or a mix? (we noted ~15% streaming but want to ensure burst calc accounts for streaming overhead).
- For the pilot, would you be comfortable with a 3-month pilot that includes a 20% burst buffer and a fixed overage rate beyond committed tokens? We can spell the exact $/1M overage in the SOW.
- Any internal procurement timelines (PO cadence / start-of-month constraints)? If you want to start in early April we can reserve dedicated warm capacity for launch.

Marissa — looping you in to craft 2 pricing scenarios: (A) 3-month committed pilot sized to 140M with 20% burst buffer, and (B) month-to-month hosted with standard committed discount tiers (no dedicated warm capacity). Please include an expected latency SLO and overage caps for each.

Thanks — I’ll queue the draft SOW once I have the small clarifications above.

Best,
Karthik

Thanks all — quick confirmation from my side:
- Pilot start: target week of April 4th.
- Budget ceiling for pilot months: we can commit up to $75k/month (prefer to stay around $65k).
- Unit economics target: aim for $700/1M tokens as the anchor in the proposal; include an option that lands at $800/1M with a higher committed volume breakpoint.
- Compliance: procurement will need SOC 2 and a basic security questionnaire completed before PO. I’ve looped Marissa on legal/compliance touchpoints.

Please send the two pricing scenarios and a short SOW + timeline by EOD Thursday so we can review internally before vendor committee.

Best,
